solid_body = solid_body - hole

slot = Pos(shaft_length - shoulder_length / 2, 0, 0) * Box(slot_length, slot_width, slot_depth)
solid_body = solid_body - slot

part = solid_body
part.name = "shaft_with_slot"
export_step(part, "output.step")
